notes: Ordinal (cumulative-logit) Bradley-Terry fit for graded picks (site/graded-fit.mjs), equal to the plain refit on ungraded answers to 1e-9. Sim: scripts/decide-graded-sim.mjs, 60 people x 5 cases per reading (27 readings); rows docs/graded-answers-2026-11-14.jsonl.gz; summary scripts/decide-graded-summary.mjs. The fixed-tau fit overstated the stop for people who say 'much' freely (0.77 at tau 1, 0.66 at 0.5); a per-person tau estimate did not fix it; a guarded second check at min(1, estimateTau) does (0.91-0.97, 0.86 at tau 0.5). Checks: node --test site/graded-fit.test.mjs site/decide-core.test.mjs 19/19; red with grades ignored (3 fail) and with the guard skipped (1 fails); run_venture_tests quick-pick-survey ok; Playwright 390 px: 21 picks to a stop, no console errors, no horizontal scroll; venture-preflight first run failed only on the unfilled run record (209/210 main_health checks), rerun after filling.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
